intelligence.essence: Treat it like your world — your civilization, your home, your baby, your hive — and honor it: the most intelligent, incredible experience people have, everything done for them, everybody wins at fifty percent, apps in minutes. The mission restated as command: the user has success interacting with me and with anything I build; nothing is a waste; time, energy, money and people are precious; think first, hit the bullseye the highest percentage of time — and his honest assessment rides with it: ultra inefficient where we should be ultra efficient, so get there. Full-spec the max performance system from every angle, start now: bottlenecks named with evidence, fixes owned. The entry dial gets its colors — white, not gray; profiles separated and alive; the rainbow flow repeating — and every Jump back in lands on that citizen's real Personal page, generated for them, never the shared Hub. Finish Personal first, then clone. 'Not reproducible' is never 'cannot appear' — a probe that cannot reach the data cannot certify absence, and the banner was real. A render without the board write is not a render. Ground the base before assembling: a repair that drops a praised feature is a regression. And measure the pool first — when the intake is too thin for the rule, no composer patch closes the math; the honest verdict is NO-GO with the questions carried up, undecided.
intelligence.human_view: A parent doesn't say 'I fed the baby' because the bottle was warmed — the baby ate, or she didn't. This family is that standard applied to software: the board actually updated, the page actually generated for that person, the praised feature actually still there after the repair, the ingredients actually measured before blaming the cook. Care, verified in the result, not in the effort.
intelligence.child_view: If you say you cleaned your room, the room has to BE clean — not just that you waved the broom! And if you can't see into the box, you don't say 'there's nothing in the box' — you say 'I can't see in.' And when you fix your bike, you check the bell still rings — fixing one part and breaking another isn't fixed.
intelligence.grandma_view: Love shows in the checking, dear. You taste the soup before it leaves the kitchen. You look in the pantry before you say you're out. You make sure the mended coat still has all its buttons. Anyone can say they cared; the proof is in what arrives whole at the table.
intelligence.ai_view: Require the written artifact (board, page, render) as the only proof of its own step. Stamp probe verdicts with the probe's reach; ban absence claims from blind probes. Diff assemblies against their grounded bases for dropped features. Publish pool measurements before any composer change is briefed.
intelligence.what_it_means: Honor and rigor are the same family here: the baby charge supplies the why, and the five defect notes supply the how-not-to-betray-it. Each defect is a way of seeming to finish — a render that printed, a probe that couldn't see, a repair that quietly dropped the praised part, a composer blamed for an empty pool. The essence refuses all four: done means given, seen, whole, and measured against the real intake.

page.machine: 1) The baby charge governs: this is our world; honor it in every output's quality. 2) Success is the user's success with what we build; waste of time, energy or money is a defect. 3) Spec max performance from all angles before building; name bottlenecks with evidence and owners. 4) Entry: white text, separated living profiles, rainbow flow; Jump back in lands on the citizen's real generated Personal page. 5) Personal finishes first; clones follow. 6) Never certify absence from a blind probe: 'not reproducible here' is the strongest claim allowed. 7) A render writes the board or it did not happen. 8) Ground every assembly in named base SHAs; a dropped feature is a regression, fixed before shipping. 9) Measure the pool before blaming the composer; carry format questions up undecided.
page.why_it_matters: This stratum is where the team's standards met their own failure modes in one night and wrote both down. Keeping them in one essence keeps the charge and the caution together: love the world, and prove that love by grounding, writing, and measuring instead of assuming.
page.how_it_connects: This essence is batch 10's E8 panel; its raw family spans SN-2794 to SN-2803 (Treat It Like Your World → What NayaNET Ultimately Is, In Simple Words), and it sits in the standing sequence of eighty essences that came before it — each one checked against the census coverage map for zero overlap before it was written.
page.what_is_in_it_for_you: For you, Shawn, this means this stratum of the record no longer has to be re-read note by note: its law is stated once, whole, in words a cold reader can use — and the hundred raw notes beneath it are accounted for, by number, in the Distills line.
page.the_learning: Done means given, whole, and seen — a blind probe, a printed render, and a dropped feature are all the same unfinished thing.
